The proposed Revision under 
Section 25 of the Provincial Small Cause 
Courts Act, 1887 has been filed against 
the judgment and decree dated 
14.11.2024, passed by learned District 
Judge, Tehri Garhwal, in SCC Suit No.03 
of 2021, by which, the learned District 
Judge, Tehri Garhwal has decreed the
said suit.

Senior Advocate assisted by Mr. Mohd. 
Matlub, learned counsel for proposed 
revisionist.

Advocate, has relied upon a judgment 
dated 30.10.2015, passed by the Hon’ble 
Allahabad High Court in Civil Revision 
No.214 of 2005, in “Sushil Kumar Soni  (Sarraf) Vs. Smt. Sheela,”.

learned Senior Advocate, list on
12.02.2025 in place of 27.12.2024.
